scope: Use the accepted Bridges root-side fresh-registry authorization mechanics for prospective G3 CPU publication and later separately admitted bank/prefix boundaries. No new authorization framework or GPU reservation.
source_guard: Only final independently accepted161source and accepted own-entry semantics; no oldG2re-sign, no whole-catalogue-exception invented here.

precedent_semantics.authority_origin: Actual Delta root preflight and current local ledger; copied remote catalogues are snapshots
precedent_semantics.registry_transfer: Read primary bytes, copy exactbytes to remote originalvirtual paths, remotehashcheck, re-read primary bytes and refuse ifchanged during transfer
precedent_semantics.publication: Root writes release locally, transfers as .pending, atomically renames remotely only after all checks

catalogue_closure: Also enumerate every live catalogue/protected-set/grader file actually consulted by final accepted owning guards. Minimum list is not permission to omit a discovered reader. Preserve exact original virtual paths, aliases and current declared protected sets.

steps.owner: Delta root, substantive checks in CPU allocation
steps.action: After161/162 acceptance and immutable final export, run the accepted source/protection/grader preflight against actual current Delta catalogue files. Capture complete bytes and SHA for all current protected registries and current own specificity-ladder entry, plus exact registered grader-file fingerprints through the accepted helper. Preserve full-catalog bytes as provenance; use only accepted own-entry semantics for scientific checks.
blocks: Protected-set content outside already reviewed complete closure
Any source or protected-set freshness failure

steps.action: Capture primary catalogue bytes before the preflight and again after it. If any required current bytes differ, discard this attempted release and rerun preflight with the actual current bytes. Do not reuse old transferred catalogue proofs.

Copy exact current catalogue bytes to the new Bridges namespace using preserved original virtual identities. Hash actual remote targets, compare to captured primary bytes, and re-read actual Delta bytes before proceeding. If changed or missing, stop. Existing immutable export ordinary source files remain unchanged; live input aliases resolve to the refreshed catalogue files.

steps.owner: Delta root; actual Bridges CPU job
steps.action: Before CPU G3 owning freeze, validate actual CPU allocation/node/account/image/source/input/cache proof and issue a finite fresh phase-specific root release binding that CPU job, accepted source/export/input manifests, namespace and current protection/own-entry fingerprints. CPU publication grants no model authority. Remote verifies body fields, current target digests and existing freshness/expiry semantics immediately before owning freeze; original owning pre/post guards still run.

Review completed genuine G3 CPU result including exact511source/4literal-link checks before and after, exact scientific comparison, actual cache geometry/tokenizer, source/protection/current-own-entry guards. Copied catalogue evidence is described as a Delta-checked snapshot, never continuous live Delta state.

steps.owner: Delta root only; future separately admitted real GPU allocation
steps.action: Before H100 bank model release, repeat current Delta preflight, stable capture/transfer/remotehash/re-read sequence. Re-read actual local ledger and immutable successor mappings, actual billing account and allocation TRES, source/export/G3/input/cache/image/protection bindings and reserved cost. Issue a fresh bank-specific release only if separately admitted. Do not implement or reserve this job from this plan.

steps.owner: Delta root only; same later GPU allocation
steps.action: Before independent prefix model construction, repeat the same current Delta/remote protection sequence and fresh stage-specific release. Recheck same actual GPU UUID/name and bank contract/numeric identity, original G3, source, cache, allocation and immutable original charge. Enforce fixed score-entry floor and finish reserve using minimum(initial EndTime,current EndTime); no walltime extension/requeue/retry. If below floor retain bank-only and stop.

At each entry require actual current release age and expiry, job/source/phase/namespace/manifest identities and digest equality to refreshed snapshots; retain all existing owning source/protection/lease guards and failure behavior. Absent, expired or mismatched release fails closed. During a stage, remote guards check mounted current snapshots under existing semantics; this plan does not claim instantaneous remote knowledge of a later Delta edit.

placement/proposal binding for exact actual job

important_limits: Existing historical authorizer automatically accepts empty protected-set catalogues only. A newly nonempty or changed set needs complete owning protection checks and independent review; never omit its closure or silently treat it as empty.
A CPU release is not a GPU reservation, numerical gate or model admission.
No current-state check is satisfied solely by a saved remote snapshot or old deployment receipt.
New accepted export or own-entry/protection mismatch blocks before freeze/model; it is not fixed by editing historical artifacts.
No new generic heartbeat framework, source exception or dropped lease guard is proposed.
Root confirmed new worktree logs target exists; earlier absence observation is obsolete and not a blocker.
